name: Correlate DNS Current Observations
description: Receives compact current observations from the external and ordinary-LAN monitors, stores bounded workflow staticData, and promotes only actionable canonical transitions to Operational Event Ingress. External direct-Midway evidence is diagnostic-only; IX clients never supply direct-Midway checks.

nodes.name: Authenticated DNS Observation Ingress
nodes.notes: Uses existing Header Auth credential metadata. No credential values are present in this export.

nodes.name: Correlate Current Observation
nodes.notes: Bounded staticData replaces unavailable Data Tables. Internal direct-Midway evidence is rejected by contract.

nodes.name: Respond Observation Accepted or Rejected
nodes.notes: Returns 400 for malformed observations and 202 after correlation state is committed; promotion is intentionally asynchronous.

nodes.name: Expand Actionable Transition Events
nodes.notes: Midway-only diagnostic transitions never appear in this queue.

nodes.name: Send Actionable Transition to Operational Event Ingress
nodes.notes: Only actionable opened/recovered canonical conditions are sent. Uses existing Header Auth credential metadata; no secret is exported.

nodes.name: Record Ingress Promotion Failure
nodes.notes: Failure is retained as bounded audit metadata after the caller already received its accepted/rejected response.

main.node: Send Actionable Transition to Operational Event Ingress
